page_title: AI for Database: AI Data Analytics in Plain English, No SQL

sources.entry: AI for Database – Connect to any database and interact with it in plain English. No SQL needed — get instant insights, build self-refreshing dashboards, and trigger automated workflows based on database changes.

summary.name: AI for Database
summary.one_liner: AI for Database is a natural-language data analytics tool that lets non-technical teams query live databases or spreadsheets in plain English, build dashboards, and set up data-triggered alerts without writing SQL.
use_cases: ask plain-English questions of a live database
build self-refreshing dashboards from query answers
alert a team in Slack or email when inventory or deal data changes
identify customers likely to churn and sync to a CRM
investigate metric changes such as refund spikes or signup drops
query company data from Claude, ChatGPT, Grok or Muse
summary.what_it_does: The tool connects to databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQL Server, SQLite, Oracle, Redis, Firebase) and Google Sheets, then answers plain-English questions by writing and running queries, showing the SQL and results. Answers can be pinned to dashboards, shared by link, or exported to Sheets or CSV, and scheduled reports are supported. Database-driven workflows can be described in a sentence and send Slack, email, webhook, or CRM updates when conditions are met. The page also describes an MCP server so AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT, Grok and Muse can query the database, and a public REST API with scoped keys for agents. Queries are described as read-only by default.
notable: Every answer includes the SQL query used, with read-only execution by default
Workflows written as plain sentences with dry-run first and logged firing
MCP server connects AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT to the database
Per-user credit balances that do not expire; self-hosting option
caveats: Paid plans: Pro is $10 per user per month and Team is $30 per user per month, with credits per payment; AI usage pauses when credits run out
Enterprise capabilities and terms are custom and agreed by contract
Workflows can send email or webhook actions, which the page says can be set to require approval
